column1: # MI1 (DUMB Korean VGA patch), L preset: 1 bpp, every charset (dialogue, sentence/verbs, card)
# in one pixel face at its 16 px design size, alpha=false in M1KOL.MAP.
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# The cell is the charset's korean<NN>.fnt header doubled (bake-scumm-fonts.sh).
# Size rule (m5_sheets.py, pixel rows): min(cell w, cell h) // 16 * 16 = 16 for every cell here;
# a cell taller than 16 puts the 16 px face in the middle: ascent = 12 (the face's own ascent
# Charset 3 has the same 16x16 cell as charset 1, so one file serves both (M1KOL.MAP points
# both at M1L1.SVF); no korean05/06.fnt exists in this patch.
# TTF paths are absolute: edit them if the fonts live elsewhere.
